title: Refund policy
text: A parcel is treated as lost after 9 working days without a carrier scan. Lost parcels are refunded in full within 4 working days of the claim, up to a ceiling of 750 EUR per parcel.

title: Refund policy
text: Damage claims need a photo of the packaging and must be filed within 14 calendar days of delivery. Approved damage claims are refunded at 80 percent of the declared value.

title: Carrier agreements
text: The standard carrier, Northwind Freight, commits to delivery within 3 working days inside the country and 7 working days cross-border. The express carrier, Halcyon Express, commits to next-day delivery for parcels under 10 kg.

title: Carrier agreements
text: Parcels above 31.5 kg are handed to the freight desk, which quotes a price manually. The freight desk answers quote requests within one working day.

title: On-call guide
text: The on-call engineer acknowledges a page within 15 minutes. If the tracking API error rate stays above 2 percent for 10 minutes, the incident is escalated to the platform lead.

title: Data retention
text: Order records are kept for 26 months after delivery and then anonymised. Session tokens are never written to logs.
